review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one real definition, `windingDatumZero_w47`. That is the trivial element of the project's own `AutomorphicForm.WindingDatum` structure, so it has no Mathlib counterpart. The other declarations are helper theorems. Some of them overlap with Mathlib lemmas, such as `norm_div_w47` (which `map_div₀` would give), `GL2_eq_of_entries_w47` and `centralScalar_comm_w47`. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening, so I did not report these. The local `good`, `goodK`, `rep` and `repK` definitions, the Λ₀ subgroup of diagonal matrices whose entry ratio lies in the range of `algebraMap`, and the Haar measure transport are all specific to this proof and have no Mathlib analogue. I did not search Mathlib's source directories; I judged these from the file and my knowledge of Mathlib. The main `solution` theorem has no competing concept, because it only combines project lemmas. I found no competing version of a Mathlib concept.
